tool_args.rationale: The forecast target H = 24.3 is more than 50 times the longest observed horizon. Measuring near H = 20 directly tests whether the response reverses sign and constrains its magnitude near the forecast target.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five positive responses at H <= 0.48 constrain the early rise but do not reliably separate the slow amplitude from its time constant.
Finer early-time sampling would refine the initial rise without directly testing the predicted late reversal.
The auxiliary measurement does not constrain the long-horizon response.
